dataSource.label: arXiv 2604.00169 — Beyond Latency: MPC and FHE for PPML (2026)

notes: FHE latency for BERT-Tiny and ResNet-20 are midpoints of reported implementation ranges (0.23–4.0 s and 0.024–7.0 s). FHE latency for BERT-Base and ResNet-50 are author estimates extrapolated from smaller models. MPC columns use LAN-F configuration (50 Gbps, 0.02 ms RTT) — best-case for MPC. Memory estimates for FHE are extrapolated by the paper authors.

models.name: ResNet-20
models.note: FHE midpoint of 0.024–7.0 s range across implementations. Small CNNs can run in leveled mode (no bootstrapping), explaining the wide variance.

models.name: BERT-Tiny
models.note: FHE midpoint of 0.23–4.0 s range. At 2 layers, a tiny transformer can fit in leveled mode — FHE is nearly competitive with MPC here.

models.name: ResNet-50
models.note: FHE requires 228 GB memory and delivers 0.006 samples/sec at batch 128, vs MPC-FSS 10 samples/sec. 50 layers require multiple bootstrapping rounds.

models.name: BERT-Base
models.note: FHE is 65× slower than MPC-A2B and needs 62× more memory. At batch 128: FHE 0.007 samples/sec vs MPC-FSS 1.5 samples/sec — a 214× throughput gap.
